provenance.graph_diagonal_proof: With all scalar Casimir graph currents assigned (d,d-1), the HL diagonal sets these currents and positive jets to zero. The potential lies in the square of the basic invariant ideal, so its slice derivatives vanish modulo the restricted invariants. The diagonal ring is therefore the nilcone intersected with the Slodowy slice. Flatness of the restricted adjoint quotient gives the regular sequence of basic Casimirs.
provenance.invariant_square_reason: The potential has degree p+1 > 6, the largest basic SO8 Casimir degree; every monomial therefore has at least two invariant factors.
provenance.method: Adjoint sl2 branching and the nilcone-slice complete intersection; two exact expansion algorithms
provenance.scope: Exact HL diagonal for the scalar Casimir graph presentation. Does not compute full Macdonald, establish physical filtration uniqueness, locate a jump or extend Schur validation.
provenance.variable_convention: z^2 = t = qT; degrees in the rational function are z degrees

principal_coordinate_equivalence.scope: The complete weighted invariant ansatz is unchanged. The triangular polynomial invariant coordinate map and its polynomial inverse induce isomorphisms on every jet algebra.

universal_source_kernel_bound.independence: At q15 the first vector has nonzero coefficient w_i*x_i on relation jet1. At q16 its derivative has nonzero coefficient 2*w_i*x_i on relation jet2. These are nonzero vectors in distinct source grades. There are no degree-one polynomial multipliers because the smallest variable degree is two.
universal_source_kernel_bound.scope: Universal lower bound only until equality with the full fixed Hilbert series supplies the specialization upper bound. No sampled generic coefficients or finite-field ranks are used.
